summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Neuberger Core Equity ETF (NBCR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund provides exposure to large-cap US companies. The actively managed fund selects equity securities using a fundamental, research-driven approach. NBCR was launched on Jul 31, 2024 and is issued by Neuberger Berman.

holdings.infoBox: NBCR is an equity ETF with a total of 204 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 7.50%, Apple at 7.02%, Microsoft at 5.99%, Alphabet at 5.34%, and Amazon.com at 3.48%.
